note: Deep-dive #3. App roles and canvas app are driven by people; SSMS screen runs on the laptop. Alex, Sam and Jordan need Power Apps Premium (trial) for the custom connector.
prepare: # owner signs in (device code), not recorded

# manual: app registrations 'Contoso Purchase Requests API' (scope PurchaseRequests.ReadWrite, roles Requester/Approver/Finance.Approver, token version 2, assignment required) and 'Contoso Purchase Requests Connector' (secret, delegated permission, admin consent); assign Alex=Requester, Sam=Approver+Requester, Jordan=Approver+Finance approver
$env:MG_API_CLIENT = Read-Host 'Purchase Requests API client id (owner types)'
az ad group create --display-name 'SQL Admins - Purchase Requests' --mail-nickname sqladmins-purchreq -o none
az ad group member add --group 'SQL Admins - Purchase Requests' --member-id (az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv)
az group create -n rg-mglab-deep-dive-03 -l westeurope -o none

az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-03 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam -p apiClientId=$env:MG_API_CLIENT sqlAdminLogin='SQL Admins - Purchase Requests' sqlAdminObjectId=$(az ad group show -g 'SQL Admins - Purchase Requests' --query id -o tsv) --query properties.outputs -o json > $env:TEMP\purchreq-outputs.json
dotnet publish src/PurchaseRequests.Api -c Release -o publish; Compress-Archive -Path publish/* -DestinationPath app.zip -Force
az webapp deploy -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-03 -n $o.webAppName.value --src-path app.zip --type zip
(Invoke-WebRequest "https://$($o.webAppHostName.value)/healthz").Content   # Healthy; slow on the first call (F1)

az sql server firewall-rule create -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-03 -s ($o.sqlServerFqdn.value.Split('.')[0]) -n laptop --start-ip-address (Invoke-RestMethod https://api.ipify.org) --end-ip-address (Invoke-RestMethod https://api.ipify.org) -o none
sqlcmd -S $env:MG_SQL03 -d purchase-requests -G -b -i sql/001-schema.sql   # owner signs in (Entra MFA)

# manual: Power Apps (DEV): custom connector 'Contoso Purchase Requests' from connector/apiDefinition.swagger.json, OAuth 2.0 with the connector app, test ListMyRequests as Alex (200 []); canvas app 'Contoso Purchase Requests' with the formulas from demo.md; share with Alex, Sam, Jordan
# manual: dry run (Alex submits 7,500, Sam refused, Jordan approves) then DELETE FROM dbo.PurchaseRequests; as SQL admin for a clean take
# 002-grant-app.sql is run on camera in the SSMS screen with @app set to the web app name

screens.name: entra-app-roles
steps: Entra admin center > Entra ID > Enterprise apps
Open Contoso Purchase Requests API > Users and groups
Show Alex Demo = Requester; Sam Demo = Approver and Requester (two rows); Jordan Demo = Approver and Finance approver (two rows)
mask: object ids and the app id

screens.name: sql-grants
steps: Connect to the SQL server (Microsoft Entra MFA as the Entra admin), database purchase-requests
File > Open > sql/002-grant-app.sql, set @app to the web app name, Execute
Show the first grid: app identity (EXTERNAL_USER) with db_datareader and db_datawriter
Show the second grid: DENY UPDATE and DENY DELETE on AuditEntries
mask: server name in the title bar, Object Explorer and connection dialog (collapse it or crop)
web app name if it appears in the script (blur it)

screens.name: app-submit
steps: Sign in as Alex Demo (own browser profile), play Contoso Purchase Requests
New request: title 'Two lab servers', justification, amount 7500, currency EUR
Open My requests: the 7,500 request shows as Pending

screens.name: app-decide
steps: Sign in as Sam Demo, play the app, open To decide, select the 7,500 request
Approve: red banner 'Requests above 5,000 EUR need a finance approver.'
Second capture: sign out, sign in as Jordan Demo (jordan.demo), Approve: status Approved
Open the audit panel: Submitted (Alex), DecisionDenied (Sam), Approved (Jordan)
mask: actorOid values in the audit panel

teardown: az ad group delete --group 'SQL Admins - Purchase Requests'
# manual: delete the custom connector and the canvas app in DEV, the two app registrations (and enterprise apps); remove Power Apps Premium trial assignments added only for this
